skill_name: Create a tutorial explaining what artificial intelligence is
workflow: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the field of computer science focused on creating machines that are capable of thinking and acting like humans. AI involves the use of algorithms and software to simulate human thought processes and behaviors. AI can be broken down into several categories like Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and Robotics.
